title: iOS 1.13 — Observed tab and live radar on the map
body:
- On flight day, a new Observed tab gathers everything measured in one place: departure and destination conditions at a glance, what's changed since your briefing, radar and lightning now, METAR/TAF and SIGMETs.
- The route map now shows live radar and satellite imagery along your route, plus an experimental storm-cell overlay showing each cell's trend and 30-minute motion.
- The live changes panel now shows how often a change has recurred today, and lists items that have recently cleared.
